attributes.name: Shortbow of Speed
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d6+4. If you would fail this check, you may put this card on top of your deck to reroll the dice; take the new result.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 1d4+2 to a combat check by a character at another location.
